name: noru
description: Hub for the Noru last-mile pieces: connect, doctor, and repository context shared by every piece.

interface.shortDescription: Connect, check and share context for the Noru last-mile pieces.
interface.longDescription: The hub for Noru's last-mile GRC pieces. It verifies the Noru MCP connection and the local toolchain, reports which scopes a piece needs, and gathers the repository context every piece reuses. Install it alongside any piece.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check my Noru connection and tell me which last-mile pieces this repository can use.
